title: AleAnna Announces Completion Of Business Combination Between Swiftmerge Acquisition Corp. And AleAnna Energy, LLC
summary: AleAnna Accelerates Efforts to Improve Italy’s Energy Sustainability And Security With Strategic Business Combination • Combination brings emerging leader in Italian natural gas and renewable natural gas to public markets • Shares of AleAnna, Inc. to begin trading on Nasdaq on December 16 under the ticker symbol “ANNA” • AleAnna stands on the cusp of a major milestone, with the first phase of natural gas production from the Longanesi Field projected to commence in the first quarter of 2025 Da
